blocking.issue: The T2-to-T3 migration rule says a Node restarted in Control mode keeps serving its active Revision until it enrolls. That contradicts pack 8.2 boot order and pack 8.11. It also contradicts Control plane and GitOps, where a Control-mode Node verifies Last-Known-Good against Ruralz Control signatures and the Environment and Cluster from its EnrollResponse. A file-mode active Revision or Last-Known-Good has neither, and a Node never merges sources. A restarted, unenrolled Control-mode Node therefore stays not ready.
blocking.evidence: Line 467: "- **No mixed modes in one Cluster.** Moving from T2 to T3 restarts each Node in Control mode with a token; it serves its active Revision until it enrolls." Pack 8.11: "In Control mode, a Node without Last-Known-Good stays not ready until it enrolls and receives its first Revision from Ruralz Control". 04-control-plane-and-gitops.md Revision signing table: "Node verification | Before activation and at Last-Known-Good boot: digest (RZ-CFG-027), both signatures, and the Environment and Cluster from its `EnrollResponse`, else RZ-CFG-033".
blocking.fix: Replace the sentence (word-neutral) with: "Moving from T2 to T3 replaces Nodes: a Node restarted in Control mode with a token stays not ready until it enrolls and activates its first Revision (pack 8.11), so move Nodes one at a time behind the load balancer, or add enrolled Nodes before draining file-mode ones."

Pack 9 separates the two commands: join joins over 8092, serve runs a Ruralz Control replica. The linked CLI and API surface document says join runs before serve and only issues the certificate. The voter is added when serve first connects over 8092 (proposed, OQ-cli-and-api-surface-14). As written, the second and third replicas are never started. T5 lists both commands with no order.
